summary: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an immersive 2D web-based simulation and training experience designed to prepare the next generation of space explorers for the rigorous realities of lunar habitation. Developed using Next.js, React, and TypeScript, the application tasks players with managing critical life-support infrastructure (ECLSS), regulating thermal systems against extreme lunar surface temperatures, and handling communications under realistic telemetry delays. By translating complex space agency data and mission constraints into interactive gameplay mechanics, the project addresses core challenges in sustainable habitat management and astronaut preparedness. It is vital because it bridges public space science literacy with engaging, hands-on learning, inspiring students and enthusiasts to understand the engineering triumphs required to sustain human life on the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
details: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive, web-based simulation and training application designed to mirror real-world lunar habitation and space mission operations. Players manage critical life-support infrastructure (ECLSS), regulate habitat thermal systems against extreme lunar surface temperatures, handle communication telemetry delays, and perform station maintenance inside a detailed pixel-art lunar module. The project uniquely merges a nostalgic 16-bit retro video game aesthetic with rigorous, authentic mission constraints inspired by NASA exploration goals.
